purpose: Validate normal-settlement implication relationships before a separate unused-price experiment. No order authority.
hypothesis: Within an identical resolution variable, YES at a strictly lower greater-than threshold and NO at a higher threshold pay at least1dollar in ordinary binary settlement states. A prospective separately frozen two-leg latency/fee/unwind test is needed before any executable-edge claim.
supported_templates: Exact CF Benchmarks sixty-second average above a numeric strike, optional dollar symbol
Exact baseball combined runs more than a numeric strike
Exact baseball team scores an integer N+ runs, corresponding floor strike N-0.5
identity: full primary rule with exactly one numeric threshold normalized
close_time_policy: Per-leg actual open and earliest close/occurrence/expected expiration must be checked at every modeled entry. Different close times do not change the semantic relationship; never trade a closed leg. This is a separate version; frozen v1 identity remains unchanged.
rejection: Missing/ambiguous/unsupported primary text, incompatible metadata strike, nonbinary market, missing shared identity fields, differing source/time/statistic rules, duplicate/equal strikes or administrative outcome uncertainty prevent execution qualification.
price_inspection: No new source prices or PnL in this rules-only audit. Future structural price experiment must freeze scope/timing/costs and unused source files first.
